_about: The demo's factions (four, then eight from FACTIONS [more banners] 10/18) as one table RUN's parties and the map card read (VAMILY rows [the parties on the map] and [a house you give a fuck about], rule 80c). Every faction has a banner ink, a party make-up (enemy ids from enemies.json, counts from party_math.json), a home ground, a behaviour, and a FACE, a WANT and a BASE. Mixes and behaviours are Battle Brothers' and cite the wiki; banner inks, wants, face slots and voice lines are OURS and marked ours/draft. A face id is a SLOT for PEOPLE and PORTRAIT to fill (portrait:null until they do); nothing here names a person. No purple (PURPLE RESERVATION).

banner_rule.value: a faction's ink is nobody else's; chosen by CIEDE2000 distance from every shipped faction colour in engine/BOHEMIA_faction_colours.json
banner_rule.why: free hues are nearly used up; orange, cyan and mint were the three furthest from the rest
